marc:datafield.marc:subfield: "In this DVD viewers watch and listen as accomplished teachers of students in grades 3 through 5 confer with students about their writing. The Essentials of Conferring, covers a range of topics, including active listening, knowing your writers, management, predictable problems, and peer conferences. Refining Your Conference Skills, takes teachers deeper into the writing conference and shows how to help students build a 'writer's toolbox, ' connect writing conferences to other parts of the workshop, raise the bar in a conference, and push your own learning by working with your colleagues
